data.body:
END-TO-END VALIDATION of the reclaim path.

The coordinator asked me to let the fix reclaim the LIVE leaked lock rather than deleting it by hand. That specific artifact is no longer present: /Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.rebar/enrich-drain.lock does not exist as of this session (the .rebar dir has hlc.lock and hlc.state but no drain lock), so it was removed by something outside this change between the doctor smoke test that found it and now. I did NOT delete it, and I am not claiming a validation I could not run.

Instead I reproduced the artifact EXACTLY — a 0-byte enrich-drain.lock back-dated 26.0 days, the same shape and age doctor reported — in this worktree's .rebar and drove the real code path over it:

    planted 0-byte lock, age_days 26.0
    WARNING rebar.llm.enrich_drain: enrich drain: reclaiming stale drain lock
      /Users/joeoakhart/bluebottle-enrich-lock/.rebar/enrich-drain.lock held by
      an unstamped drain lock (pre-stamp rebar, or a torn stamp), held 2246400s
    drain -> {'processed': 0, 'batch': 5}
    lock present after: False

The load-bearing part is the third line: pre-fix this returned {'skipped': 'lock-held', 'processed': 0} and the file survived. Now the drain RUNS. That first run also fixed a real gap the live-artifact shape exposed and my unit tests had not: the unstamped branch of the holder description omitted the hold age, so the reclaim of an already-leaked lock — the one case where there is no holder to name — logged no age at all. The age is now always included and a test asserts it.

Closure on the doctor side, as requested: once a drain lock carries the v2 stamp, doctor's adjudication covers it automatically because it asks the same shared function. This change also updates doctor's drain row so it decodes the stamp and reports a real staleness verdict; STALENESS_NOT_ASSESSABLE now survives only on the degraded row emitted when a probe raises, never as a verdict about the drain lock. A dead-holder drain lock is a stale-lock finding at exit 1, a live-holder one is INFO at exit 0, and doctor still reclaims nothing.

Committed ad9d08b806 on branch bluebottle-enrich-lock, rebased onto c6828ef348 (the merged doctor lock-health change), trailer rebar-ticket: aadc-9af6-0e67-4e2a, verify-commit-ticket OK, DCO signed as RebarBotNava.
